LanguageData.RIH_AllowCorpsesTip: Off by default. Corpses are then carried in the hands as in vanilla.
LanguageData.RIH_AllowAnimals: Tamed animals haul with their inventory
LanguageData.RIH_AllowAnimalsTip: Pack animals that are allowed to haul use their inventory.
LanguageData.RIH_MinimumFreeCapacityTip: Pawns whose worn gear leaves less free capacity than this haul in their hands as in vanilla.
LanguageData.RIH_MaxStacksPerTripTip: Upper limit for how many separate stacks one trip collects. Weight and the inventory grid still apply.
LanguageData.RIH_SharedStorage: Several haulers share storage that holds many stacks per cell
LanguageData.RIH_SharedStorageTip: Shelves, cellars and other buildings with more than one stack per cell accept as many haulers at once as they have free stacks, up to 32.
LanguageData.RIH_BuildFromInventory: Build with materials from the own inventory
LanguageData.RIH_BuildFromInventoryTip: A builder first uses fitting materials they carry. Food, drugs and medicine only count if they were hauled.
LanguageData.RIH_BuildFromOtherInventories: Take materials from the inventories of other colonists
LanguageData.RIH_BuildFromOtherInventoriesTip: If nothing lies on the map, builders take materials out of the inventories of other colonists.
LanguageData.RIH_LoadForConstruction: Load several stacks for large construction sites
LanguageData.RIH_LoadForConstructionTip: When a construction site needs more than one stack, the builder fills the inventory and the hands before walking over, then delivers everything on site.
LanguageData.RIH_HighlightHauled: Highlight hauled items in the gear tab
LanguageData.RIH_HighlightHauledTip: Gold frame in the True RPG Inventory grid and tinted drop button in the vanilla gear tab for items that will be unloaded into storage.
